title: UMQF calibration observation
description: One priced-harm data point (a guideline cell, tariff entry, award, or anchor figure). Stored one-object-per-line in data/observations/<source>.jsonl. Plain text, RAG-indexable, DuckDB-queryable in place.

summary.description: one natural-language sentence (for RAG) stating the figure and what it prices

harm_magnitude.description: 0..1 severity, fraction toward death=1 (null for a pure money/anchor figure)

money_value_usd2024.description: headline money figure normalized to 2024 USD

money_value_gcu.description: money_value normalized to Global Currency Units (USD / local lifetime throughput); income-invariant, used for all conversion (backfilled by categorize_ai/gcu.py)

harm.description: optional zoom-in: sub-particles of the harm

informs_ratio.description: L_to_M | W_to_M | W_to_L | In | money_concavity | liberty_time | severity_ladder

legal_tradition.description: value-system family; used to measure cross-system universality (independent traditions count more than correlated jurisdictions)

entity_type.description: the entity whose value is priced; default human. Reserved for future non-human calibration (the formula aims to be universal across life forms).

construct.description: what a money figure measures: wtp=willingness-to-pay (VSL), compensation=make-whole (diyya/wrongful-death/tort), budget=cost-effectiveness threshold (QALY). Different constructs are NOT comparable and must never be averaged together.
